name: Support-Overwatch - Guardian Angel in the Net

system.story: Runs the team's side of the Wired - the purest force-multiplier.

description.value:
Subclass: Support-Overwatch - the Guardian Angel in the Net. Runs the team's side of the Wired: feeding allies edges, jamming incoming fire, guarding the crew's chrome and comms, and watching the Alert clock for everyone. The purest force-multiplier.

Role Feature - Overwatch Uplink

As a maneuver, grant an ally an edge on their next action by feeding them targeting/intel data; while you hold any node, allies in your net resist hostile hacking and smartgun-jamming (you guard their chrome).

Signature Tweak

Ghost the Log can be used on an ally's action - extending Alert-mastery to the whole crew.

Bonus Skill & Contact

An interpersonal or Perception skill, plus a fixer or matrix-support contact.

Chrome Flavor

A networked support deck with wide-band comms and team-uplink rigging.
